details.report: Closed the remaining StatsLine ratio-state invariant at the public validator seam. `validateStatsLineV1` now requires `unclassifiable-receipt` exactly when recorded unclassified receipts are nonzero; it rejects that reason when zero and rejects measured or `no-apply-receipts` ratios when unclassified receipts exist. Added the three exact table-driven contradiction regressions, preserved the producer’s receipt-byte complement law and all existing metric validation, and regenerated `dist/stats-line.js`. No findings were declined. Verification passed: focused StatsLine tests (6/6), typecheck, isolated-HOME full suite (354 tests: 349 pass, 5 skip), package entrypoint/lifecycle including cold tarball install (7/7), source/dist parity coverage, npm pack dry-run, and diff check. Forward commit: bc8eafd7eef1b6fef9366a64962dcd62df29527f.
